sentences.text: Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
Application stands disposed of.
This is a petition seeking quashing of FIR No. 80/2017 dated 27.03.2017 u/s 498A/406/34 IPC and Section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act registered at PS Harsh Vihar.
The petitioners are present through VC and are identified by Mr. Dinesh Kumar Malhotra, Adv.

Respondent No. 2 is also present through VC and is identified by Mr. Raj Kumar Jain, Adv.
A DD of Rs. 50,000/- has already been given to respondent No. 2.
The parties state that they have arrived at the settlement dated
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 24/09/2023 at 20:48:09 07.12.2020, wherein the parties have settled their disputes.

However, clause 6 of the settlement is contrary to the judgment of 'Ganesh vs. Sudhirkumar Srivastava' [(2020) 20 SCC 787], according to which, the rights of the minor child, Ms. Yashika cannot be settled by the parents.

For the said reason, this order and clause 6 of the settlement shall not come in the way of the minor child, Ms. Yashika claiming her rights of inheritance, maintenance, education and matrimonial rights against either of the parties.
